name: Notoya Moe
source:
She became interested in cosplay in the summer of her first year of junior high school. She saw a special feature on TV that made her want to try "becoming someone different from herself." She participated in the event in the spring of her second year of junior high school. She became friends with Layer, who she met at the first event she participated in. Since then, they have participated in the event as much as possible together. The activity's name is "MoA."

She goes to the same high school as [url=https://vndb.org/c113706]Shouko[/url]. She lacks confidence and has a shy personality. She's bad at expressing emotion. As "MoA", she is a little more social.

[Translated from [url=https://saya-sp.com/hanasaya_gp_op/layer_if/layer_ifb_character/]official website[/url]]
